newsitem.title: USA: CME live cattle end mixed, Dec down on liquidation.
newsitem.headline: CME live cattle end mixed, Dec down on liquidation.

text.p: CME live cattle settled mixed, with December under pressure from speculative long liquidation, and feeders closed higher on moderate losses in corn, CME floor traders said.
Most of the liquidation came from frustrated or "tired" longs who watched the market react with lackluster action to news of higher wholesale beef and fed cattle prices this week, floor traders said.
Losses were not heavy because many bulls anticipate that fed cattle prices will climb $1.00 higher next week or at least trade steady with this week's price of $71.00 per cwt.
